query: Marvell Technology custom AI silicon revenue fiscal 2026 quarterly
normalized: 2026 ai custom fiscal marvell quarterly revenue silicon technology

output.content:
Marvell did **not publicly report custom AI-silicon revenue as a quarterly standalone line item in fiscal 2026**; it disclosed end-market **data-center revenue** quarterly and later stated that its **custom business generated $1.5 billion for FY2026** (year ended January 31, 2026), approximately double the prior year. [[1]]

| Marvell fiscal 2026 quarter | Quarter end | Data-center revenue | Commentary on custom AI silicon |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Q1 | May 3, 2025 | **$1.441bn** | Management said results and Q2 outlook were driven by the rapid scaling of AI-silicon programs into high-volume production; this is not a separately quantified custom-silicon figure. [[2]]|
| Q2 | Aug. 2, 2025 | **$1.491bn** | Marvell identified strong AI demand for custom silicon and electro-optics as a driver, but did not disclose custom-silicon revenue alone. [[3]]|
| Q3 | Nov. 1, 2025 | Not separately retrieved here | The company reported total revenue of **$2.075bn** and said data-center-product demand drove the quarter; it did not provide a disclosed standalone custom-AI-silicon revenue figure in the cited results. [[4]]|
| Q4 | Jan. 31, 2026 | **$1.650bn** | Management subsequently characterized the full-year custom business as **$1.5bn**, but Q4 custom revenue itself was not separately reported. [[1]]|

For context, total company revenue rose from **$1.895bn in Q1** to **$2.006bn in Q2**, **$2.075bn in Q3**, and **$2.219bn in Q4**; FY2026 revenue was **$8.195bn**. [[5, 3, 4, 6]] 

The key interpretation is that **$1.5bn is a full-year custom-business figure, not a quarterly series**, and it should not be equated with Marvell’s broader data-center revenue because that end market also includes electro-optics and other products. [[1]]
